The Council of Twelve takes its shape from the blessing of Jacob (Gen 49): twelve differentiated shards - Reuben precedence, Simeon severity scattered, Levi sanctuary, Judah sceptre, Zebulun haven, Issachar burden, Dan judge, Gad troop last, Asher dainties, Naphtali goodly words, Joseph shepherd-stone, Benjamin divider. Given by the operator's pointer to the KJV in-corpus.
